paragraphs.text: Every flat in the building has a smoke alarm in the hallway. Test your alarm once a month by pressing the button until it sounds. If the alarm makes a short beep every minute, the battery needs to be replaced.
Do not leave cooking unattended, and keep tea towels and paper away from the cooker. Most fires in the building in the last five years started in kitchens.
The fire doors on each landing must be kept closed at all times. They are designed to stop smoke spreading to the stairs, which are the only escape route.
If you discover a fire, leave the building immediately and call the fire service from outside. Do not use the lift. The meeting point is the car park opposite the main entrance.
A fire alarm test takes place every Monday at 10 am. If you hear the alarm at any other time, treat it as a real emergency and leave the building.

items.quote: Test your alarm once a month
items.prompt: Residents should test their smoke alarm once 1 ____.

explanation.en: “Test your alarm once a month” → a month. “Once” is already in the sentence, so write the two remaining words.
explanation.kk: «Test your alarm once a month» → a month. «Once» сөйлемде тұр, қалған екі сөзді жазамыз.
explanation.ru: «Test your alarm once a month» → a month. «Once» уже стоит в предложении, пишем два оставшихся слова.

items.quote: the battery needs to be replaced
items.prompt: If the alarm beeps every minute, the 2 ____ must be changed.

explanation.en: A short beep every minute means “the battery needs to be replaced”. “Changed” paraphrases “replaced”, so the answer is battery.
explanation.kk: Минут сайын қысқа дыбыс шығуы «the battery needs to be replaced» дегенді білдіреді. «Changed» — «replaced» дегеннің басқаша айтылымы, жауап battery.
explanation.ru: Короткий сигнал каждую минуту значит, что «the battery needs to be replaced». «Changed» пересказывает «replaced», ответ battery.

items.quote: keep tea towels and paper away from the cooker
items.prompt: Tea towels and paper should be kept away from the 3 ____.

explanation.en: “keep tea towels and paper away from the cooker” → cooker. “Kitchens” in the next sentence is where fires started, not what to keep towels away from.
explanation.kk: «keep tea towels and paper away from the cooker» → cooker. Екінші сөйлемдегі «kitchens» — өрт шыққан жер, орамалды алыс ұстайтын нәрсе емес.
explanation.ru: «keep tea towels and paper away from the cooker» → cooker. «Kitchens» во втором предложении — место пожаров, а не то, от чего держать полотенца.

items.quote: They are designed to stop smoke spreading to the stairs
items.prompt: Fire doors are designed to stop smoke from reaching the 4 ____.

explanation.en: “stop smoke spreading to the stairs” → stairs, plural as in the text.
explanation.kk: «stop smoke spreading to the stairs» → stairs, мәтіндегідей көпше түрде.
explanation.ru: «stop smoke spreading to the stairs» → stairs, во множественном числе, как в тексте.

items.quote: The meeting point is the car park opposite the main entrance
items.prompt: After leaving the building, residents should go to the 5 ____ opposite the main entrance.

explanation.en: “The meeting point is the car park opposite the main entrance” → car park. “Lift” and “fire service” are other instructions.
explanation.kk: «The meeting point is the car park opposite the main entrance» → car park. «Lift» пен «fire service» — басқа нұсқаулар.
explanation.ru: «The meeting point is the car park opposite the main entrance» → car park. «Lift» и «fire service» — другие указания.
